title: Greg Landsman
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Greg Landsman (Democratic Party) is a member of the U.S. House, representing Ohio's 1st Congressional District. He assumed office on January 3, 2023. His current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Landsman (Democratic Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent Ohio's 1st Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
